verdict.rationale: Greptile documents several first-party handoff paths. Every review comment has a 'Fix with your Agent' button that sends the issue, with file paths, line numbers and suggested code, to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Conductor or Devin, and a 'Fix All' button sends every issue at once. An official MCP server connects Cursor, Claude Code and Codex, with /check-pr and /greploop auto-fix commands, and `greptile review --agent` outputs each catch as raw text with a suggested fix for an agent to apply. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent handoff works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, review findings hand off cleanly to my coding agent — copyable fix prompts or direct integration with Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex

citations.quote: Every review comment includes a Fix with your Agent button that sends the issue — with file paths, line numbers, and suggested code — straight to Claude Code, Codex, Conductor, Cursor, or Devin.
A Fix All button in the review summary sends every issue at once.
Connect Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, or Codex to Greptile MCP with OAuth.
`greptile review --agent` outputs every greptile catch as raw text with a suggested fix for your agent to apply.
Run `/check-pr` to fix all review comments on a PR, or `/greploop` to iterate until Greptile gives a 5/5 confidence score.
